_source.title: 获取焊盘
_source.params.primitiveIds: 焊盘的图元 ID，可以为字符串或字符串数组，如若为数组，则返回的也是数组
_source.returns: 焊盘图元对象，`undefined` 表示获取失败

title: Get Pad
params.primitiveIds: Pad primitive ID, which can be a string or an array of strings. If it is an array, an array is also returned
returns: Pad primitive object, `undefined` indicates that the retrieval failed
